title: Jobs
description: The lines under the jobs they belong to. Move a line with its menu, then save the work order.
name: Name
deleteDescription: Its lines stay on the document, under Other.
saveHint: Jobs are saved at once; a line moved to another job is saved with the rest of the form.
loadFailed: The jobs could not be loaded.
saveFailed: The job could not be saved.
designerByJobHint: By job prints each job's name, its lines and its subtotal; a document with jobs prints that way unless another grouping is chosen here. Category groups the part lines by their category.
